origins.section: 3.1 Every Connection Holds a Thread Until It Closes
3.3 A Listener Holds Up Its Own Connection
3.4 A Frame the Server Can't Unpack Ends the Connection
3.6 A TLS Server Checks Client Certificates Only With `serverauth`

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-firewall-week: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-firewall-week: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-firewall-week: 3.1 says timeout 0 disables the read timeout, a dropped flow leaves a dead session holding a thread on each reconnect, and when the pool is gone ISOServer closes its listening socket while 'the connections that hold the threads keep working'.
recorded.prompt:q-fraud-call: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-fraud-call: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-fraud-call: 3.3: 'nothing more is read from it until process returns', and the A/B run shows A's second purchase at 4 s and B's at 2 s; scaling to 3 x 3 s versus 3 s is a short inference.
recorded.prompt:q-bad-frame-then-reversal: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-bad-frame-then-reversal: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-bad-frame-then-reversal: 3.4: 'The server answered neither ... closed the connection, so the valid echo right behind the bad frame was never read'; a session ends on any ISOException by default.
recorded.prompt:q-laptop-certificate: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-laptop-certificate: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-laptop-certificate: 3.6: with clientauth=true, serverauth=false the self-signed stranger got in; the factory builds a trust manager from its keystore only when serverauth is true, otherwise it accepts any certificate.

recorded.prompt:q-firewall-week:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-firewall-week:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-firewall-week:b: Refuted by 'The connections that hold the threads keep working, which is why the old terminals in the opening still transact.'
recorded.prompt:q-firewall-week:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-firewall-week:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-firewall-week:c: Refuted by 'The terminal reconnects on a new connection ... and the old session stays.'
recorded.prompt:q-firewall-week:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-firewall-week:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-firewall-week:d: Refuted by 'Without the property the channel's default is 300000 ms' together with 'timeout 0, which disables the read timeout'.
recorded.prompt:q-fraud-call:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-fraud-call:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-fraud-call:b: Refuted by 'every session calls that one instance, concurrently' and A's and B's lookups running at the same time.
recorded.prompt:q-fraud-call:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-fraud-call:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-fraud-call:c: Refuted by 3.1's one session thread per accepted connection and 3.3's 'Only the session thread that called process reads that connection'.
recorded.prompt:q-fraud-call:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-fraud-call:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-fraud-call:d: Refuted by 'A's second purchase took four: it sat unread in the connection while the session waited for A's first lookup'.
recorded.prompt:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:b: Refuted by short inference: the page says the session closed the connection and the following message was never read, so nothing is held back.
recorded.prompt:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:c: Refuted: reading on past the bad frame happens only with ignore-iso-exceptions; 'A server session, by default, ends on any ISOException'.
recorded.prompt:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-bad-frame-then-reversal:d: Refuted by 'The server answered neither' and 'The bad purchase still gets no answer'.
recorded.prompt:q-laptop-certificate:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-laptop-certificate:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-laptop-certificate:b: Refuted by inference: the same self-signed stranger is rejected (certificate_unknown) with serverauth=true, so self-signing does not make it trusted; it got in only because of the accept-anything trust manager.
recorded.prompt:q-laptop-certificate:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-laptop-certificate:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-laptop-certificate:c: Refuted by '`clientauth` makes a certificate mandatory, and `serverauth` decides whether it is verified'.
recorded.prompt:q-laptop-certificate:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-laptop-certificate:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-laptop-certificate:d: Refuted by the run where the self-signed stranger got 0810 with serverauth=false.
